concerns.advisory: The new hand-rolled flexbox mixins emit legacy 2009-spec prefixes (`-webkit-box`, `-moz-box`, `-ms-flexbox`) that a modern build pipeline's autoprefixer would already handle, so the project now has two competing sources of vendor prefixes to keep in sync.
concerns.why: app/assets/stylesheets/common/foundation/mixins.scss adds `flexbox()`, `inline-flex()`, `align-items()`, `order()` that hardcode prefixes; badges.css.scss simultaneously replaces plain `display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline;` with those mixins.

concerns.advisory: The `order()` mixin maps a single value onto both `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` (1-based, legacy) and `order` (0-based default, modern), which means the same numeric argument produces different relative positioning semantics across the two engines.
concerns.why: `@mixin order($val)` sets `-webkit-box-ordinal-group: $val;` and `order: $val;` from one argument; `.extra-info-wrapper` uses `order(2)` and `.panel` uses `order(3)` while sibling children get no explicit order at all.

concerns.advisory: Only two of the header's flex children get an explicit `order`, so the final layout depends on unordered siblings defaulting to 0 (modern flexbox) versus 1 (legacy `-webkit-box`), making visual order browser-dependent rather than declared.
concerns.why: topic.scss `.extra-info-wrapper { @include order(2); }` and header.scss `.panel { @include order(3); }` are added, but `.contents`' other children (e.g. `.title`, `.valign-helper`) receive no order.

concerns.advisory: Removing `.title { float: left; }` and `.panel { float: right; }` changes the layout contract that downstream themes, plugins, and mobile/desktop override stylesheets may have been written against.
concerns.why: header.scss deletes the `.title` float rule entirely and swaps `.panel`'s `float: right` for `margin-left: auto`, which only works when the parent is a flex container.

concerns.advisory: `.badge-wrapper { float: left; }` is retained inside `.extra-info-wrapper`, but floats are ignored on flex items, leaving a now-inert declaration that will mislead future maintainers about how the badge is positioned.
concerns.why: topic.scss keeps `.badge-wrapper { float: left; }` while the surrounding header `.contents` becomes `@include flexbox()`.

concerns.advisory: `.small-action-desc` switches from fixed `em`-based padding to a percentage (`0 1.5%`), making the gutter scale with container width instead of font size, which changes small-action spacing at narrow/wide viewports.
Vertical rhythm compensations are removed in several places and re-derived from flex centering plus a single `line-height: 1.5`, so any theme or plugin relying on the old explicit spacing will shift.
concerns.why: Deletions of `.badge-wrapper.bullet { margin-top: 5px; }`, `p { margin: 5px 0; }` → `margin: 0`, and `> p { padding-top: 4px; }`, offset by the new `line-height: 1.5` on `.extra-info-wrapper`.

concerns.advisory: This is a purely visual layout refactor of the topic header and small-action rows with no accompanying visual-regression coverage or screenshots, so alignment breakage would only be caught by manual review.
concerns.why: The diff touches four stylesheets affecting header, topic, small-action, and badge layout and adds no test or screenshot artifact.

concerns.advisory: The `align-items()` mixin forwards its argument verbatim to `-webkit-box-align`/`-ms-flex-align`, whose legacy keyword vocabularies differ from modern flexbox, so future call sites using values like `flex-start` or `space-between` will silently emit invalid legacy declarations.
concerns.why: `@mixin align-items($alignment)` performs no value mapping between `-webkit-box-align`, `-ms-flex-align`, and `align-items`.
